experiment: E1 -- T6 Fisher-metric survey + T7 bijector curvature
status: proposed (UNCERTIFIED) -- grader inspects artifacts, not this summary

render_path.W: 1/err_map**2 (err_map FIXED: Dataset built it once from the OBSERVED image via background_rms=0.2, exp_time=100; z-independent)
render_path.chi2_aux_convention: log_prob(z)[1] is REDUCED chi^2 = chi2_total/event_size; chi2_from_aux = aux * prob_model.event_size
render_path.amplitude_params_note: mode=forward => Sersic Ie amplitudes are ORDINARY sampled params; they enter J(z) as ordinary columns (no lstsq layer).

hessian_note: H_post = -Hessian(log_prob[0]) includes prior + logdet terms; for r this is intended -- r bounds EVERYTHING-not-GN (residual second-order + prior) on the stiff subspace. M for r is the RAW-z GN metric J^T W J.

standardization.z_space_units: zhat = z/std_z ; J_zhat = J_z*std_z ; Delta zhat = Delta z/std_z

r_values.interpretation: r << 1 => GN/manifold curvature dominant on stiff subspace; r >~ 1 => residual/prior terms matter. NOT adjudicated.

T6.prediction: top-vector rotation >= 15 deg at ~h* separations (0.0035 z-units), growing ~linearly below sigma
T6.falsifier: median rotation < 3 deg at h*-scale => the curved-valley reading of T3 is wrong

T7.jackpot_branch: z/theta rotation ratio >~ 3 => transform-induced curvature is a major term (prior/bijector redesign)
T7.innocent_branch: ratio ~ 1 => curvature is intrinsic physics (reparameterize the physical family)
